notes.title: Fear the Timeloop: Prologue is officially out on Steam! 🔁🕒
notes.content:
[h3]Fear the Timeloop: Prologue is [i]officially out[/i] on Steam! 🔁🕒
[/h3][p]Step into the boots of Sheriff James Cooper, who’s slowly bleeding out in a mysterious hospital… but death isn’t the end — it’s just the beginning. With only 15 minutes to break the cycle, uncover the truth, and escape the loop, every second counts.
[/p][p]Can you outsmart time itself?
 ⏳ Play the free Prologue now and test your wits.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3642660/Fear_the_Timeloop__Prologue/"][/dynamiclink]
[/p]

notes.title: Fear The Timeloop Has Found a Publisher — PlayWay S.A.
notes.content:
Hello, friends! We’re excited to share some great news — Fear The Timeloop now has a publisher! Our project has been picked up by the renowned publishing company [b]PlayWay S.A.[/b], known for supporting numerous successful indie games and helping them reach new heights.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45080349/0c6588936996479aabd97f3b724926fa01936213.png[/img]

This is an important step for us and for the game. PlayWay S.A. will handle the promotion of the project and help us bring it to a wider audience, while we continue to refine Fear The Timeloop, adding new elements and polishing every detail to ensure an unforgettable experience for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45080349/d294f904b8f9433b57c407669204af5136f7ad09.png[/img]

We want to thank everyone who has supported us along the way. Your belief in the project helped us reach this milestone, and now we’re ready to move forward. Add Fear The Timeloop to your wishlist, stay tuned for updates, and get ready to embark on a thrilling and terrifying journey!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45080349/e87e87d7e6f5f2c1e0f0cd9d0daf3592520bb2d4.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Upcoming Changes and Improvements
notes.content:
Dear Players,

First and foremost, thank you for your continued support and invaluable feedback on Fear The Timeloop. We’ve taken the time to carefully analyze all your suggestions and have already begun implementing significant changes to enhance the gameplay experience. Here’s a detailed look at what’s coming:

[list]
[*] [b]Reworked Character Controller[/b]: We are completely overhauling the character controller to deliver more realistic and immersive movement.
[*] [b]Improved Combat System[/b]: The combat system is currently being rewritten and enhanced for a more engaging and fluid experience.
[*] [b]Audio Fixes During Interactions[/b]: Background sounds will no longer pause when interacting with objects, ensuring a more seamless audio environment.
[*] [b]Graphics and Optimization Upgrades[/b]: Both graphics and performance optimization are receiving major improvements to make the game look and run better than ever.
[*] [b]Integrated Flashlight Mechanic[/b]: The flashlight will no longer be a separate item. Players will now have easier and more intuitive access without needing to hold it manually.
[*] [b]Refined Dialogues[/b]: Any dialogues that do not align with the game’s overall tone will be removed or reworked to better fit the atmosphere.
[/list]

While these changes bring us closer to delivering the experience you deserve, they also require additional development time. [b]As such, we must inform you that the release of Fear the Timeloop will be postponed to the second quarter of next year[/b].

We understand that delays can be disappointing, but we are confident that this extra time will allow us to meet the high expectations we’ve set for the game. To keep you updated, we will begin posting regular developer logs (devlogs) on both our Steam page and Discord server moving forward.

Thank you for your patience and understanding. We’re working hard to ensure Fear the Timeloop exceeds your expectations, and we can’t wait to share more with you soon.

Sincerely,
Fear the Timeloop Development Team

notes.title: Demo 1.3 Update
Demo 1.2 Update
notes.content:
I am excited to announce that the demo version of Fear The Timeloop has been updated to [b]1.2![/b] Here are the changes and improvements made in this update:

[list]
[*]Removed additional confirmation for picking up most non-essential items.
[*]Fixed an issue with saving the teddy bear in the inventory.
[*]Fixed an issue with saving the sprint state after restarting the game.
[*]Added a marker indicating the room the player is currently in.
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support and feedback! Enjoy the updated demo!

notes.title: Fear The Timeloop: Demo 1.1 Update
notes.content:
I am excited to announce that the demo version of Fear The Timeloop has been updated to [b]1.1[/b]! Here are the changes and improvements made in this update:

[list]
[*]Added one more cassette for saving in the safe room.
[*]The safe room now restores more health while staying in it.
[*]Reduced the aim window, requiring less time for the aim to center.
[*]Hints no longer overflow their frames in other languages.
[*]Fixed issues with the flashlight.
[*]Added Italian and Ukrainian languages.
[*]Resolved collision issues with some items.
[*]Slightly increased performance.
[*]Reduced the game's file size a bit.
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support and feedback! Enjoy the updated demo!

notes.title: DEMO LAUNCHES IN SEVEN DAYS
notes.content:
I'm excited to announce that the demo for my survival-horror game, Fear The Timeloop, will be available starting October 11th. This demo offers a glimpse into the early stages of the game, introducing players to the main character, Sheriff James Cooper, and the mysterious circumstances he finds himself in.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45080349/f37645a54055a1af74f6d31a4af6cf283af852a2.png[/img]

You'll experience the tense atmosphere and uncover the first pieces of the intricate storyline, setting the stage for the full experience to come. This is just the beginning of a gripping, time-twisting adventure. I look forward to hearing your thoughts and feedback as you explore the eerie world of Fear The Timeloop.
